name: image-viewer
purpose: Shows photos, scans, and screenshots inline or in a gallery lightbox (a modal dialog): zoom by wheel, pinch, buttons, and keys; pan by drag and arrow keys; rotate; fit and actual size; previous and next with a thumbnail strip; and a crop mode with aspect ratio presets that produces a canvas and a Blob. Every image needs alt text, and image URLs are limited to safe schemes.
whenToUse: Inspecting scanned documents, receipts, or ID photos that need zoom and rotation.
A gallery of attachments opened from a list or a file manager.
Cropping an uploaded photo (profile pictures, document scans) before saving it.
whenNotToUse: A single decorative image in content: use a plain img.
A slideshow of marketing content: use Carousel.
Editing images beyond crop and rotation (filters, drawing).
responsive: The stage fills the available inline size (inline height from --aui-image-viewer-height, default 24rem; the lightbox fills the viewport); the toolbar and the crop bar wrap; the thumbnail strip scrolls horizontally; fit recomputes on resize.
rtl: The header, toolbar, crop bar, and thumbnails follow the writing direction; previous and next chevrons are mirrored, and ArrowLeft moves to the next image in RTL when the image is not zoomed. Image transforms are physical.
theme: Component tokens image-viewer-stage-bg (color-surface-sunken), image-viewer-crop-border (color-focus-ring), image-viewer-crop-overlay (color-backdrop), image-viewer-thumb-selected (color-primary), and image-viewer-radius (radius-md); the text, crop outline, current thumbnail ring, and focus indicator pairs are in the contrast gate. Forced colors draw the crop area and the current thumbnail in Highlight.
security: Image URLs are limited to https:, blob:, raster data:image (png, jpeg, gif, webp, avif, bmp; never svg+xml), and the document's own origin; javascript:, file:, and cross-origin http: URLs throw. Alt text and captions are set as text. Transforms are custom properties set through the CSSOM, never style attributes. Cross-origin images can only be cropped when they are served with CORS and crossOrigin is set; otherwise the crop is refused with aui-error.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access beyond loading the given images, or telemetry. Crop output stays in memory (a canvas and a Blob) for the application to upload.

budgets.budget: One style update of custom properties; no layout of the image

performance.testedScale: 500 images per viewer; images up to 8,000 by 8,000 pixels (crop canvases are limited by the browser's canvas size).

limitations: Rotation is in steps of 90 degrees.
Crop rectangles are axis aligned; there is no free rotation or perspective correction.
The download link uses the download attribute, which browsers ignore for cross-origin URLs (they open the image instead).
unsupported: SVG images (data:image/svg+xml) and other script-capable formats.
Image editing beyond crop and rotation.
antiPatterns: Using the file name as alt text; describe what the image shows.
Loading full-size originals as thumbnails for large galleries; pass thumbnail URLs.
Cropping without telling the user the result size; the crop area announces it.
